<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Um convite pra Lurdes Vanessa 🌊</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fredoka:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Quicksand:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --sand:#FFF3E4;
    --peach:#FFCBA4;
    --coral:#FF8C69;
    --pink:#FF6F91;
    --ocean:#3E8FB0;
    --deep:#274156;
    --ink:#2D3047;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;}
  body{
    min-height:100vh;
    font-family:'Quicksand', sans-serif;
    color:var(--ink);
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(30,25,20,.35), rgba(20,25,35,.55)),
      url('data:image/jpeg;base64,');
    background-size:cover;
    background-position:center;
    background-attachment:fixed;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    padding:24px;
    overflow-x:hidden;
    position:relative;
    cursor:default;
  }
  h1,h2,h3,.display{
    font-family:'Fredoka', sans-serif;
  }
  .card{
    width:100%;
    max-width:460px;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.82);
    backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
    border-radius:28px;
    padding:36px 26px;
    box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(20,20,20,.35);
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
    text-align:center;
  }
  .card::before{
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    top:-60px; right:-60px;
    width:160px; height:160px;
    background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,111,145,.35), transparent 70%);
    border-radius:50%;
  }
  .step{ display:none; animation:fadeUp .5s ease; }
  .step.active{ display:block; }
  @keyframes fadeUp{
    from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(14px);}
    to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0);}
  }
  .eyebrow{ font-size:14px; color:var(--ocean); margin-bottom:6px; letter-spacing:.02em; }
  .title{
    font-size:24px;
    font-weight:600;
    color:var(--deep);
    margin:0 0 8px;
    line-height:1.3;
  }
  .subtitle{
    font-size:15px;
    color:#5b5b6b;
    margin:0 0 26px;
    line-height:1.5;
  }
  .btn-row{
    position:relative;
    display:flex;
    flex-wrap:nowrap;
    gap:14px;
    justify-content:center;
    min-height:60px;
    align-items:center;
  }
  button{
    font-family:'Fredoka', sans-serif;
    border:none;
    cursor:pointer;
    border-radius:999px;
    padding:13px 22px;
    font-size:16px;
    font-weight:600;
    transition:transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .btn-yes{
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--coral), var(--pink));
    color:#fff;
    box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(255,111,145,.4);
  }
  .btn-yes:hover{ transform:scale(1.06); }
  .btn-yes:active{ transform:scale(.97); }
  .btn-no{
    background:#fff;
    color:var(--deep);
    border:2px solid #e4d9cc;
  }
  .btn-no.dodging{
    position:absolute;
  }
  .no-msg{
    margin-top:14px;
    font-size:13px;
    color:var(--pink);
    min-height:18px;
    font-weight:600;
  }
  .suggestion{
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF6EC, #FFE9D6);
    border:1px dashed var(--coral);
    border-radius:16px;
    padding:14px 16px;
    font-size:14px;
    color:var(--deep);
    margin-bottom:22px;
    text-align:left;
    display:flex;
    gap:10px;
    align-items:flex-start;
  }
  .suggestion span.icon{ font-size:20px; }
  input[type="date"], input[type="time"], input[type="text"]{
    font-family:'Quicksand', sans-serif;
    width:100%;
    padding:14px 16px;
    border-radius:14px;
    border:2px solid #e4d9cc;
    font-size:16px;
    color:var(--ink);
    background:#fff;
    margin-bottom:18px;
  }
  input:focus{
    outline:none;
    border-color:var(--coral);
  }
  .chip-grid{
    display:flex;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
    gap:10px;
    justify-content:center;
    margin-bottom:16px;
  }
  .chip{
    background:#fff;
    border:2px solid #e4d9cc;
    border-radius:999px;
    padding:9px 16px;
    font-size:14px;
    font-weight:600;
    cursor:pointer;
    color:var(--deep);
    transition:all .15s ease;
    font-family:'Quicksand', sans-serif;
  }
  .chip.selected{
    background:var(--ocean);
    border-color:var(--ocean);
    color:#fff;
  }
  .quick-dates{
    display:flex;
    gap:8px;
    justify-content:center;
    margin-bottom:16px;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .quick-dates button{
    background:#fff;
    border:2px solid #e4d9cc;
    color:var(--deep);
    font-size:13px;
    padding:9px 14px;
  }
  .quick-dates button.selected{
    background:var(--coral);
    border-color:var(--coral);
    color:#fff;
  }
  .field-label{
    font-size:13px;
    color:#5b5b6b;
    text-align:left;
    margin:0 0 8px;
    font-weight:600;
  }
  .primary-btn{
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ocean), var(--deep));
    color:#fff;
    width:100%;
    padding:15px;
    font-size:16px;
    box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(39,65,86,.35);
  }
  .primary-btn:disabled{
    opacity:.45;
    cursor:not-allowed;
  }
  .primary-btn:not(:disabled):hover{ transform:translateY(-2px); }
  .final-emoji{ font-size:48px; margin-bottom:10px; }
  .recap{
    background:#fff;
    border-radius:16px;
    padding:16px 18px;
    margin:18px 0;
    font-size:14px;
    color:var(--deep);
    text-align:left;
    border:1px solid #f0e4d4;
  }
  .recap b{ color:var(--pink); }
  .heart{
    position:fixed;
    top:-10%;
    font-size:22px;
    opacity:.85;
    animation:fall linear forwards;
    pointer-events:none;
    z-index:5;
  }
  @keyframes fall{
    to{ transform:translateY(115vh) rotate(360deg); opacity:0; }
  }
  .kiss{
    position:fixed;
    font-size:24px;
    pointer-events:none;
    z-index:50;
    animation:kissFloat 1.1s ease-out forwards;
  }
  @keyframes kissFloat{
    0%{ transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.6); opacity:0; }
    20%{ opacity:1; transform:translate(-50%,-70%) scale(1.1); }
    100%{ transform:translate(-50%,-160%) scale(1); opacity:0; }
  }
  .dots{
    display:flex;
    gap:6px;
    justify-content:center;
    margin-top:22px;
  }
  .dot{
    width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%;
    background:#e4d9cc;
  }
  .dot.on{ background:var(--coral); }
  @media (max-width:360px){
    button{ padding:12px 16px; font-size:14px; }
    .title{ font-size:21px; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="card">

  <!-- STEP 1 -->
  <div class="step active" id="step1">
    <div class="eyebrow">um convite especial pra Lurdes Vanessa</div>
    <div class="title">Vamos para a praia? 🏖️</div>
    <p class="subtitle">Só preciso de uma resposta bem simples...</p>
    <div class="btn-row" id="btnRow">
      <button class="btn-yes" id="btnYes">Sim!</button>
      <button class="btn-no" id="btnNo">Não</button>
    </div>
    <div class="no-msg" id="noMsg"></div>
    <div class="dots"><div class="dot on"></div><div class="dot"></div><div class="dot"></div><div class="dot"></div></div>
  </div>

  <!-- STEP 2: DATA -->
  <div class="step" id="step2">
    <div class="eyebrow">passo 2 de 3</div>
    <div class="title">Que dia combina melhor? 📅</div>
    <div class="suggestion">
      <span class="icon">☀️</span>
      <span>Sugestão minha: <b>este sábado</b>, se fizer calor. Mas escolhe o dia que preferires.</span>
    </div>
    <div class="quick-dates" id="quickDates"></div>
    <input type="date" id="dateInput">
    <button class="primary-btn" id="toStep3" disabled>Confirmar dia</button>
  </div>

  <!-- STEP 3: HORA + EXTRA -->
  <div class="step" id="step3">
    <div class="eyebrow">passo 3 de 3</div>
    <div class="title">A que horas te apanho? ⏰</div>
    <div class="chip-grid" id="timeChips">
      <div class="chip" data-time="09:00">🌅 Manhã cedo</div>
      <div class="chip" data-time="13:00">🌞 Depois do almoço</div>
      <div class="chip" data-time="16:00">🌇 Fim da tarde</div>
    </div>
    <input type="time" id="timeInput">

    <div class="title" style="font-size:18px; margin-top:24px;">O que não pode faltar? 🧺</div>
    <div class="chip-grid" id="extraChips">
      <div class="chip" data-item="Bebida">🥤 Bebida</div>
      <div class="chip" data-item="Comida">🍉 Comida</div>
      <div class="chip" data-item="Protetor solar">🧴 Protetor solar</div>
      <div class="chip" data-item="Boa música">🎶 Boa música</div>
      <div class="chip" data-item="Bola">🏐 Bola</div>
    </div>
    <p class="field-label">Ou escreve a tua própria ideia:</p>
    <input type="text" id="customExtra" placeholder="ex: uma boa companhia 😌">

    <button class="primary-btn" id="toStep4" disabled>Fechar o plano</button>
  </div>

  <!-- STEP 4: FINAL -->
  <div class="step" id="step4">
    <div class="final-emoji">🥰🌊</div>
    <div class="title">Combinado, Lurdes Vanessa!</div>
    <p class="subtitle">Obrigado por dizer sim. Contigo, até um dia comum vira o meu favorito — mal posso esperar pra ver o teu sorriso com o mar atrás.</p>
    <div class="recap" id="recap"></div>
    <p class="field-label" id="sendStatus" style="text-align:center; margin-top:10px;">A enviar a tua resposta… 💌</p>
    <button class="primary-btn" id="retrySend" style="display:none;">Tentar enviar novamente</button>
    <p class="subtitle">Nos vemos lá. Traz só o teu sorriso, o resto a gente combina. 💛</p>
    <p class="subtitle" style="margin-bottom:0; font-weight:700; color:var(--deep);">Com amor, teu best Clávio Bahama</p>
  </div>

</div>

<script>
  // ---------- Falling hearts ----------
  function spawnHeart(){
    const h = document.createElement('div');
    h.className = 'heart';
    h.textContent = ['💛','🌊','🐚','☀️','💗'][Math.floor(Math.random()*5)];
    h.style.left = Math.random()*100 + 'vw';
    h.style.animationDuration = (5 + Math.random()*4) + 's';
    h.style.fontSize = (16 + Math.random()*14) + 'px';
    document.body.appendChild(h);
    setTimeout(()=>h.remove(), 10000);
  }
  setInterval(spawnHeart, 900);

  // ---------- Kiss on every click ----------
  document.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
    const k = document.createElement('div');
    k.className = 'kiss';
    k.textContent = '💋';
    k.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
    k.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
    document.body.appendChild(k);
    setTimeout(()=>k.remove(), 1100);
  });

  // ---------- STEP 1: dodge button ----------
  const btnRow = document.getElementById('btnRow');
  const btnNo = document.getElementById('btnNo');
  const btnYes = document.getElementById('btnYes');
  const noMsg = document.getElementById('noMsg');
  const phrases = [
    "hmm, tenta outra vez 😌",
    "esse botão é rápido, eu sei 🏃‍♀️",
    "só o sim funciona por aqui 💛",
    "quase! mas não 😜",
    "ele foge porque a resposta é sim 🌊"
  ];
  let scale = 1;
  function moveNo(){
    const rowW = btnRow.clientWidth;
    const rowH = btnRow.clientHeight;
    const bw = btnNo.offsetWidth;
    const bh = btnNo.offsetHeight;
    const maxX = Math.max(rowW - bw, 0);
    const maxY = Math.max(rowH - bh, 0);
    const x = Math.random()*maxX;
    const y = Math.random()*maxY;
    btnNo.style.left = x + 'px';
    btnNo.style.top = y + 'px';
    noMsg.textContent = phrases[Math.floor(Math.random()*phrases.length)];
    scale = Math.min(scale + 0.06, 1.6);
    btnYes.style.transform = 'scale(' + scale + ')';
  }
  ['mouseenter','click','touchstart'].forEach(evt=>{
    btnNo.addEventListener(evt, (e)=>{
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      btnNo.classList.add('dodging');
      moveNo();
    });
  });

  btnYes.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
    e.stopPropagation();
    goToStep(2);
  });

  // ---------- STEP navigation ----------
  function goToStep(n){
    document.querySelectorAll('.step').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active'));
    document.getElementById('step'+n).classList.add('active');
    document.querySelectorAll('.dot').forEach((d,i)=>{
      d.classList.toggle('on', i < n);
    });
  }

  // ---------- STEP 2: date ----------
  const dateInput = document.getElementById('dateInput');
  const quickDates = document.getElementById('quickDates');
  const toStep3 = document.getElementById('toStep3');

  function fmt(d){
    return d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
  }
  function fmtPretty(d){
    return d.toLocaleDateString('pt-PT', { weekday:'long', day:'numeric', month:'long' });
  }
  const today = new Date();
  const dayLabels = ['Hoje','Amanhã'];
  const quickOptions = [];
  for(let i=0; i<7; i++){
    const d = new Date();
    d.setDate(today.getDate() + i);
    let label;
    if(i < dayLabels.length){
      label = dayLabels[i];
    } else {
      label = d.toLocaleDateString('pt-PT', { weekday:'short' });
      label = label.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + label.slice(1).replace('.', '');
    }
    quickOptions.push({label:label, date:d});
  }
  quickOptions.forEach(opt=>{
    const b = document.createElement('button');
    b.type = 'button';
    b.textContent = opt.label;
    b.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      e.stopPropagation();
      dateInput.value = fmt(opt.date);
      document.querySelectorAll('.quick-dates button').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('selected'));
      b.classList.add('selected');
      toStep3.disabled = false;
    });
    quickDates.appendChild(b);
  });
  dateInput.min = fmt(today);
  dateInput.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
    document.querySelectorAll('.quick-dates button').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('selected'));
    toStep3.disabled = !dateInput.value;
  });
  toStep3.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ e.stopPropagation(); goToStep(3); });

  // ---------- STEP 3: time + extras ----------
  const timeChips = document.querySelectorAll('#timeChips .chip');
  const timeInput = document.getElementById('timeInput');
  const extraChips = document.querySelectorAll('#extraChips .chip');
  const customExtra = document.getElementById('customExtra');
  const toStep4 = document.getElementById('toStep4');
  let selectedExtras = [];

  timeChips.forEach(c=>{
    c.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      e.stopPropagation();
      timeChips.forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('selected'));
      c.classList.add('selected');
      timeInput.value = c.dataset.time;
      checkStep3();
    });
  });
  timeInput.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
    timeChips.forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('selected'));
    checkStep3();
  });
  extraChips.forEach(c=>{
    c.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      e.stopPropagation();
      c.classList.toggle('selected');
      const item = c.dataset.item;
      if(selectedExtras.includes(item)){
        selectedExtras = selectedExtras.filter(i=>i!==item);
      } else {
        selectedExtras.push(item);
      }
    });
  });
  function checkStep3(){
    toStep4.disabled = !timeInput.value;
  }
  toStep4.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
    e.stopPropagation();
    buildRecap();
    goToStep(4);
    enviarResposta();
  });

  // ---------- STEP 4: recap ----------
  const DEST_EMAIL = 'claviochitsulete@icloud.com';
  let recapData = { dataStr:'', horaStr:'', extrasStr:'' };

  function buildRecap(){
    const d = new Date(dateInput.value + 'T00:00:00');
    const dataStr = fmtPretty(d);
    const horaStr = timeInput.value;
    let extras = [...selectedExtras];
    if(customExtra.value.trim()){
      extras.push(customExtra.value.trim());
    }
    const extrasStr = extras.length ? extras.join(', ') : 'só a boa vibe mesmo';
    recapData = { dataStr, horaStr, extrasStr };
    document.getElementById('recap').innerHTML =
      '📅 <b>Dia:</b> ' + dataStr + '<br>' +
      '⏰ <b>Hora:</b> ' + horaStr + '<br>' +
      '🧺 <b>Levar:</b> ' + extrasStr;
  }

  // ---------- Envio automático via FormSubmit ----------
  const sendStatus = document.getElementById('sendStatus');
  const retrySend = document.getElementById('retrySend');

  async function enviarResposta(){
    sendStatus.textContent = 'A enviar a tua resposta… 💌';
    retrySend.style.display = 'none';

    if(location.protocol === 'file:'){
      sendStatus.innerHTML = 'Não consigo enviar automaticamente abrindo o ficheiro direto no computador.<br>Este site precisa de estar hospedado online (ex: Netlify, GitHub Pages) pra o envio funcionar sozinho.';
      return;
    }

    try{
      const response = await fetch('https://formsubmit.co/ajax/' + DEST_EMAIL, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'Accept': 'application/json'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          _subject: 'Lurdes Vanessa disse SIM para a praia! 🏖️',
          _template: 'table',
          _captcha: 'false',
          'Nome': 'Lurdes Vanessa',
          'Dia': recapData.dataStr,
          'Hora': recapData.horaStr,
          'Não pode faltar': recapData.extrasStr
        })
      });

      const result = await response.json().catch(()=>({}));
      const msg = String(result.message || '').toLowerCase();

      if(msg.includes('activation') || msg.includes('activate')){
        sendStatus.innerHTML = 'Quase lá! O Clávio precisa de ativar o envio uma única vez: verifica a caixa (e o Spam) de <b>' + DEST_EMAIL + '</b> e clica em "Activate Form". Depois disso, os próximos envios são automáticos.';
        retrySend.style.display = 'block';
        return;
      }

      if(!response.ok || result.success === 'false' || result.success === false){
        throw new Error('SEND_FAILED');
      }

      sendStatus.textContent = 'Resposta enviada! O Clávio já sabe de tudo. 💛';
    } catch(err){
      sendStatus.textContent = 'Não consegui enviar agora. Verifica a ligação à internet e tenta de novo.';
      retrySend.style.display = 'block';
    }
  }

  retrySend.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
    e.stopPropagation();
    enviarResposta();
  });
</script>

</body>
</html>
